# care-home-cqc-mcp

> CQC Single Assessment Framework (SAF) compliance for adult social care + care homes. Maps Quality Statements to evidence + AI-tool governance.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- map_to_quality_statement
- ai_tool_governance_check
- notifications_audit
- mcap_template
- medication_administration_log_check

## Install
```
pip install care-home-cqc-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/care-home-cqc-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
